title: ATS Scores Aren’t Real (Stop Believing This)
description:
If someone told you your resume “failed the ATS score”… that’s not actually how hiring works.

There is no universal ATS score.

Recruiters aren’t rejecting you because you got a 72%. They’re reading your resume like a human — scanning for relevance, clarity, and proof you can do the job.

If you’ve been obsessing over keywords and trying to “beat the ATS,” you’re focusing on the wrong thing.

What actually matters:

Clear positioning
Relevant experience
Showing you can solve the problem
